notes: quiz.chart proposals (Stop @101 and Target @76 as 'reveal markLines') were REJECTED. Engine fact (lt-engine.js): markLines are read from def.markLines and render in BOTH pre-cut and revealed states (buildCandlestickOption never swaps them) — there is NO revealMarkLines mechanism; only revealMarkPoints (line 1005) are reveal-gated. Adding either as a markLine would render PRE-CUT and spoil the bearish/bullish decision by drawing a 'Stop above pocket — short' and 'Target below — next S/R' before the user answers. Expressing them as floating reveal pins is also unsound: a markPoint snaps to a candle's high/low (it cannot float ABOVE the swing for a stop), and the top slot at idx9 / bottom slot at idx15 are already occupied by existing reveal pins. The decision quiz already reveals the short entry (idx9) and the rejection outcome (idx15); per the restraint + no-spoiler rules, the Stop/Target — mentioned only generically in the rule — are best left to the explanation text rather than forced onto the chart with an unsupported mechanism. introChart and lessonChart edits above are mechanism-safe and text-justified; quiz.chart is left as-is.
